method_note: League-wide MLB trend scan: record vs the MODEL'S OWN spread (not a sportsbook spread; n >= 20 decided games), hottest/coldest teams by run differential (only with > 2k teams), hot/cold bats (L7 OPS), starting-pitcher form. Context, not recommendations. Suppressed in the offseason.
season_note: MLB offseason: no games on the board, so the MLB trend tiles are suppressed until Opening Day.
